name: Way of Shadow
summary: Ninja-like monks who move through darkness.

features.name: Shadow Arts
features.short: Spend 2 ki to cast Darkness, Darkvision, Pass without Trace or Silence.
features.summary: You can spend 2 ki points to cast Darkness, Darkvision, Pass without Trace or Silence without material components. You also learn Minor Illusion.

features.name: Shadow Step
features.short: Bonus action: teleport between shadows, then attack with advantage.
features.summary: While in dim light or darkness, as a bonus action you teleport up to 60 ft. to another dim or dark space you can see. Your next melee attack before the end of the turn has advantage.

features.name: Cloak of Shadows
features.short: Action: become invisible in dim light or darkness.
features.summary: As an action while in dim light or darkness, you become invisible until you attack, cast a spell or are in bright light.

features.name: Opportunist
features.short: Reaction: attack a creature that was just hit by someone else.
features.summary: When a creature within 5 ft. is hit by an attack made by someone other than you, you can use your reaction to make a melee attack against it.
